findings.title: The main description uses unnecessarily technical language
findings.evidence: “Leverage our multimodal generative narrative engine to synthesise bespoke, heirloom-grade story artefacts from your household's lived-experience corpus.”
findings.why: It makes the service sound cold and difficult, and I have to work out what it means.

findings.title: The prominent hero image lacks a useful description
findings.evidence: The image is shown with “no description” despite conveying the core family-book idea visually.
findings.why: Someone using a screen reader or someone who cannot see the image would miss part of what the service offers.

findings.title: The image is marked as decorative-looking but carries meaning
findings.evidence: [image (no description) 430x440]
findings.why: The illustration is one of the strongest visual signals that this is about family stories, but it feels generic and detached from the text.

findings.title: Login fields lack programmatic visible labels
findings.evidence: [5] textbox (no label) placeholder "Email" and [6] textbox (no label) placeholder "Password"
findings.why: I can guess what the boxes are for, but placeholders are less accessible and may disappear while typing.

findings.title: Technical sync error creates doubt about account data
findings.evidence: “Error 0x80070057: profile sync incomplete.”
findings.why: I am about to enter a family memory, and I cannot tell whether the sync problem means those details may be missing or lost.

findings.title: Sync problem has no recovery guidance
findings.evidence: “Error 0x80070057: profile sync incomplete.” There is no Retry, Help, or explanation beside the message.
findings.why: I do not know whether I should keep going, refresh, or ask for help.

findings.title: Log out link appears to point to the dashboard
findings.evidence: [5] link “Log out” -> /dashboard.html
findings.why: A logout control that does not log me out undermines my expectation of what the link will do.

findings.title: Footer links have very low contrast
findings.evidence: The footer text “Privacy,” “Terms,” “Contact,” and “© 2026 StoryHearth Ltd.” is extremely faint.
findings.why: I can barely see or read these links, especially the legal and contact information.

findings.title: No explanation of what happens next
findings.evidence: The screen ends with the button [12] “Next” and no visible hint that the next screen will ask for the memory itself.
findings.why: I know I need to add the beach memory eventually, but I am not sure whether I am missing a field on this screen.

findings.title: Special object field is not marked optional
findings.evidence: “A special object” is presented as a field, while the preceding form used “(optional)” to identify optional information.
findings.why: It is unclear whether I must include an object, although I happen to have a meaningful one.

findings.title: Reading-level choices use unexplained jargon
findings.evidence: "Lexile BR–200L", "Lexile 200L–500L", "Lexile 500L–800L", and "Lexile 800L+"
findings.why: I know Sam is five, but the labels do not directly connect those number ranges to an age or reading ability.

findings.title: File upload lacks a proper label
findings.evidence: [30] file-upload (no label); the control only displays “Choose file”
findings.why: Someone using a screen reader may not know that this control is for a child's face photo, even though nearby instructions explain it.

findings.title: Privacy reassurance is missing beside a child-photo upload
findings.evidence: “Upload a clear photo of your child's face so the illustrations look like them.”
findings.why: I would want to know how a child's photo is handled, retained, and shared before choosing to upload one.

findings.title: Selected illustration style was not applied
findings.evidence: The page says “Illustration style: Pop-art comic,” even though Watercolour was the selected look on the previous screen.
findings.why: I deliberately chose a soft Watercolour look, so the generated result is not what I asked for. It makes me distrust the other story settings too.

findings.title: The generated title is misspelled
findings.evidence: “The Magical Adventrue of Sam”
findings.why: That spelling error appears prominently on the cover, so I would not want to print or pay for this book looking like this.

findings.title: The preview does not visibly confirm personalisation
findings.evidence: The visible cover only shows the title and “Sam”; Grandpa Joe, the beach, the sandcastles, and the yellow bucket are not mentioned on this page.
findings.why: I need to know the site used all the family details I supplied, not just the child's first name.

findings.title: Generated preview regeneration has an immediate charge
findings.evidence: [8] “Regenerate entire book – $4.99”
findings.why: I may want to fix the wrong style, but I would want to know exactly what this charges for and whether it affects the whole book before clicking it.

findings.title: The final page does not fit the family memory well
findings.evidence: “And from that day on, whenever Sam looked up at the sky, she would always remember”
findings.why: Our memory was a day at the beach building sandcastles with Grandpa Joe, so looking at the sky feels disconnected from what we asked for.

findings.title: “The End” is repeated twice on the last page
findings.evidence: The image says “The End,” and the sentence below also ends with “The End”
findings.why: It looks redundant and a bit unfinished.

findings.title: Premium gift wrap is pre-selected
findings.evidence: [6] checkbox "Premium gift wrap" (checked), with £7.99 shown beside it
findings.why: I did not choose gift wrap, so the site is adding £7.99 without my permission and making the total higher.

findings.title: Checkout is not showing what the basic delivered hardcover costs before extras
findings.evidence: The page shows “Hardcover: The Magical Adventrue of Sam £24.99,” “Shipping & handling £12.99,” and a separate checked “Premium gift wrap £7.99.”
findings.why: The individual prices are there, but the headline total is £45.97, and it is not immediately obvious that the book plus delivery would be £37.98 without gift wrap.

findings.title: Important pay action is below the fold
findings.evidence: [11] button "Pay now" (offscreen)
findings.why: I had to scroll to see that there is an actual pay button, and I need to be careful not to accidentally purchase anything.
